columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer organization party.

columns.name: DUNS_NUMBER
columns.description: DUNS number in varchar format. Column value is not restricted to the nine digit D-U-N-S number.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_ID_NUM
columns.description: Taxpayer identification number.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_REGISTRATION_NUM
columns.description: Registration number of the taxpayer.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the customer organization party.

columns.name: GSA_INDICATOR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the business is served by the General Services Administration. Valid values are: Null, Y, and N.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the customer account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the customer account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: User-defined description of the customer account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of customer account, based on the CUSTOMER_TYPE lookup. For example, I for internal customers, R for revenue generating external customers.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the customer account was originally created.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CLASS
columns.description: Identifier of the customer class, based on the CUSTOMER_CLASS lookup. For example, Education for educational customers.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PROFILE_CLASS
columns.description: Name of the customer profile class.

columns.name: SITE_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the party site.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer party site.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the customer party site.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account site.

columns.name: ACCT_ADDRESS_SET_CODE
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional user interfaces.

columns.name: LOCATION_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the party site address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_1
columns.description: First line of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_2
columns.description: Second line of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: MAIL_STOP
columns.description: User-defined code to indicate a mail drop point within the customer site address.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_3
columns.description: Third line of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINE_4
columns.description: Fourth line of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: BUILDING
columns.description: Name of the building for the customer site address.

columns.name: FLOOR_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the floor of the building for the customer site address.

columns.name: HOUSE_TYPE
columns.description: If required by the country of the customer site address, the type of house described in the address, such as detached, semi-detached, colonial, or bungalow. Values are based on the HZ_HOUSE_TYPE lookup type.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE1
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE2
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE3
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE4
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: ADDR_ELEMENT_ATTRIBUTE5
columns.description: Additional address element to support flexible address format.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: Province of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: POSTAL_PLUS4_CODE
columns.description: Four digit extension to the United States postal code.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: County of the address for the customer site.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Country code from the TERRITORY_CODE column in the FND_TERRITORY table. For example, US for United State of America, DE for Germany.

columns.name: ADDRESS_LINES_PHONETIC
columns.description: Phonetic representation of address lines, such as those used in Japan.

columns.name: ADDRESS_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Complete description of the customer site.

columns.name: ADDR_SHORT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Short description of the customer site.

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Timezone code from the FND_TIMEZONES_B table.

columns.name: SALES_TAX_GEOCODE
columns.description: US state and local tax jurisdiction code. Use this field to provide either a Vertex GeoCode or Taxware Geocode value for the Point of Order Origin.

columns.name: SALES_TAX_INSIDE_CITY_LIMITS
columns.description: Indicates whether a location is inside the boundary of a city, based on the associated GeoCode. It is used to calculate state and local taxes in the United States. Values are Y for locations within the city limits, and N for locations outside the city limits.

columns.name: IDENTIFYING_ADDRESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the customer site address is the identifying address for the customer organization. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: ACCT_SITE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Default language code for the party site.

columns.name: TRANSLATED_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Customer name in the language of the site.

columns.name: CUST_SITEUSE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account site purpose.

columns.name: SITE_USE_CODE
columns.description: Business purpose assigned to the customer site, such as bill-to, ship-to or sold-to.

columns.name: SITE_USE_PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the business purpose assigned to the customer site is the primary business purpose. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: SITE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the associated customer site. Value must be unique for accounts in a set.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUST_SITE_REF
columns.description: Bill-to site address linked to the ship-to site purpose.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Receipt method name that is associated with the bill-to site.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the receipt method assigned to the customer site is the primary receipt method. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the receipt method assigned to the customer site is valid.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: UPLOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the parent job that processes this record.

columns.name: UPLOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the upload status of this record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
